title: Supervisor-Worker Routing
hints: A worker is eligible only if its skills contain every tag the subtask needs: set(needs) <= set(skills).
Use min over (len(queue[w]), w) so ties go to the alphabetically first name, whatever order the workers came in.
Rounds: loop over sorted worker names, pop at most one subtask per worker per round, until every queue is empty. A reassigned subtask goes to the back of its new worker's queue.
Track which workers already failed a subtask and how many times it was reassigned. One reassignment, never back to a worker that failed it.
